Name: Location Label
Author: MissViciousCirce
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#EFC04A]✦ Location Label ✦[/color][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
Location Label adds small gold text to the bottom left corner of your screen, showing where you are as you explore 

[color=#EFC04A][size=4]✦ A little sense of place[/size][/color]
Your location updates as you explore. Named locations from expansion mods are supported 

Inside the Mines and Skull Cavern, the label also shows your current floor.

[color=#EFC04A][size=4]✦ Make it yours[/size][/color]
Adjust the text size and position through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to find a spot that feels right for your screen.

[color=#EFC04A][size=4]✦ What you’ll need[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.5.2 or newer[/b][/*]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15 [/b][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [i](optional, for in game settings)[/i][/*]
[/list]
[color=#EFC04A][size=4]✦ Getting started[/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Extract the [b]LocationLabel[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[i]Updating? Keep your existing [b]config.json[/b] to preserve your settings.[/i]
